from pathlib import Path
import re,json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_multidim_fiscal_deposit_cause_score_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record=json.loads((OUT/'长期状态更新回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
repairs=[]
for name in ['docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md']:
 p=ROOT/name;before=p.read_bytes();fixed=re.sub(rb'\r+\n',b'\r\n',before)
 assert p.read_bytes()==before
 p.write_bytes(fixed)
 for item in record['changes']:
  if item['path']==name:
   item['before_newline_normalization_sha256']=item['after_sha256']
   item['after_sha256']=sha(p)
 repairs.append({'path':name,'duplicate_carriage_returns_removed':before.count(b'\r\r\n'),
                 'after_sha256':sha(p),'meaningful_document_text_unchanged':True})
record['newline_normalization']=repairs
record['finalized_at']=datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
(OUT/'长期状态更新回执.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for item in repairs:print(item['path'],'换行已统一；去除重复回车',item['duplicate_carriage_returns_removed'])
